memo: Filters menu open; after two 'l' presses highlight should be on 'Light and Shadow' (its submenu items have no status hint, which explains the stale status text). Pressed Right to open the Light and Shadow submenu. Next: press 'v' or use Down arrows to reach 'Vignette...' (GIMP 2.10 order: Gradient Flare, Lens Flare, Sparkle, Supernova, Drop Shadow, Long Shadow, Vignette, Xach-Effect), then Enter. If nothing opened, highlight was still on 'Reset all Filters' - do NOT press Enter there (it would reset plug-in settings); instead press Escape and retry.
